notes: Achroma: a strictly monochrome, single-page interactive field guide to seeing without colour. Six movements — a prelude, a 24-step grey ladder with keyboard roving focus, live canvas halftone and dither plates (threshold, Bayer 8x8, Floyd-Steinberg), a pointer-driven extruded-type shadow study, and a colophon. All imagery is generated at run time (tiled film grain, procedurally drawn landscape and shaded sphere, hand-written SVG dial); no external requests, no dependencies, no build step, relative paths only, so it opens from file:// and from a GitHub Pages subfolder. Known limitations: system font stacks rather than a bespoke typeface; the clipboard write falls back to execCommand and reports honestly if both routes are unavailable; the hero dial and shadow study respond to pointer movement only and are decorative (aria-hidden) rather than keyboard-operable.
